packagegui.name: zapret2
packagegui.title: Zapret2 DPI Bypass
packagegui.description:
GUI management package for zapret2 — a DPI bypass tool for circumventing deep packet inspection on FreeBSD/pfSense. Provides profile-based configuration, service management, and a health check utility.
NOTE: This is an MVP/experimental release. The zapret2 backend (nfqws/tpws) must be installed separately before using this package. See INSTALL.md.
